summary: Add `st tiles run` and `st tiles stop`, root-only commands that run a command as a registered tile: its own Unix user, namespaces and root-owned cgroup.

replay.detail: New root-only commands; no claim kinds, replay or persisted daemon state change.

schema.detail: No database or graph schema change.

compatibility.detail: Opt-in: nothing runs unless root writes /etc/st-tiles/tiles.toml and runs st tiles. Existing seats, sekrets and the daemon are unchanged.

manual.detail: Nothing to do on upgrade. The root-only proofs (ST_TILES_ROOT_TEST=1 tiles_root) are not run in CI; they were run on a root host for this change.

recovery.detail: Nothing to recover; st tiles stop ends a tile and removing the registry disables tiles.
